comment: The independent reading of Nintendo's figures this package is held to. Pinned by commit so a build is reproducible, and lifted function by function so only the three that decide a format are compiled.
why: Every figure in this package's record was read off a rendered page by one person. Nothing checked that reading. A misreading present in both the record and the code agrees with itself, round-trips perfectly through the exhaustive walk, and passes every gate here. What catches it is somebody else's reading of the same figures, which is what this is.

reference.name: SuperFamiconv
reference.author: David Lindecrantz
reference.why: A converter whose whole job is these formats, rather than an emulator that decodes them on the way to a screen. Its bitplane, colour and map-entry code is separable and reads the same figures this package does.
